checks.individual_pixels: All eight inspected at 8x on light checker, dark neutral and approved seasonal grass. Hard pixel clusters, no blur, anti-aliased edges, fringe, halo, or detached speck noise visible. Every sprite has one 8-connected opaque component and alpha values only 0/255.
checks.size_and_placement: All eight are 48x48 RGBA, transparent outside the tree, fully inside their cells. Trunk bases end on row 44 and are centred around x=23/24; this matches the named reference sheet, whose tree feet normally end on row 44 (one on 45). The three blank bottom rows are not a placement failure.
checks.light: Upper-left foliage and trunk highlights, with deeper lower/right masses, remain consistent with the approved art.
checks.random_8x2: Viewed at native 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x. Each sprite occurs twice in a seeded shuffle. Silhouette differences remain readable; no accidental rectangular border or cell-edge cut-off.
checks.forest: Viewed dense jittered forest, an additional fixed 24px-by-16px staggered lattice, and a ragged forest edge at 1x and 4x. Later rows cover earlier rows. Crown masses remain legible under overlap; no asset-imposed square grid, uniform crown stamp or repeated texture seam warrants rejection. The imposed lattice has the expected staggered placement, without turning into identical crown wallpaper.
checks.approved_art: Compared at 1x and 4x with out/ markers across all six settings; round-2 city, suburb, slums, industry, farmland and farmstead examples; paddies; summer/autumn grass and plains bases and details. Pixel density, muted colours and dark accents sit comfortably beside these. Comparison assets were not assigned new verdicts.
checks.other_parts: 3x3 seamless-base tiling, mountain range QC, crater/ruin/cyberpunk checks and winter consistency are not applicable: Part D contains only summer and autumn transparent tree sprites. No files from Parts A, A2, B or C were reviewed.
checks.brief: Pass: round crowns 0/3/6, tall ovals 1/4/7, and two-lobed crowns 2/5, in olive/yellow-green, sage and dark green families. Reusing a crown class does not make these near-duplicates; edges, clumps, proportions and palette differ visibly.

file_observations.treeline_forest-0: Round olive crown with an irregular lower edge and separate lit clumps; the right-hand shadow and visible fork read at 1x.
file_observations.treeline_forest-1: Tall sage oval, narrow enough to contrast with the round crowns; broad upper-left highlights remain readable in the forest.
file_observations.treeline_forest-2: Wide yellow-green two-lobed crown with a clear saddle and fork; distinct from the upward-sweeping, darker tree 5.
file_observations.treeline_forest-3: Round dark-green crown with offset upper mass and hanging right lobe; distinguishable from the olive round variants in silhouette and value.
file_observations.treeline_forest-4: Tall olive oval with stacked, asymmetric lobes; its colour and clump arrangement distinguish it from sage ovals 1 and 7.
file_observations.treeline_forest-5: Dark-green two-lobed crown with a low left mass and raised right mass; asymmetric fork and silhouette survive sparse and dense placement.
file_observations.treeline_forest-6: Round yellow-green crown with a large upper-left leaf mass and an open, shadowed lower centre; distinguishable from the more fragmented tree 0.
file_observations.treeline_forest-7: Tall sage crown with a bent upper tuft, notched left side and uneven right contour; distinct clumps from the smoother oval 1.

treeline_forest.calibration: Good enough to ship beside the approved art. No concrete redraw defect found after the required visual checks.
treeline_forest.previous_review: critic-r5D-0.json does not exist; no previous pass was overturned.

file_observations.treeline_forest@autumn-1: Muted orange tall oval; narrow silhouette breaks up the orange round and wide crowns.

file_observations.treeline_forest@autumn-3: Muted red round crown; clearly separated from the orange family without a neon or pink highlight clash.
file_observations.treeline_forest@autumn-4: Muted red tall oval; narrow taper and diagonal clumps separate it from round red tree 3.
file_observations.treeline_forest@autumn-5: Gold two-lobed crown with unequal heights; the distinct dark lower mass keeps it from flattening into the gold ground.
